name: Angelic Sleuth
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever another permanent you control leaves the battlefield, if it had counters on it, investigate. (Create a Clue artifact token with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
blocked_sentences: Whenever another permanent you control leaves the battlefield, if it had counters on it, investigate. (Create a Clue artifact token with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

needs.what: a last-known-information test of whether the permanent that just left the battlefield had ANY counters (of any kind) on it, usable as an intervening-if condition on a leaves_battlefield trigger -- e.g. a `had_any_counters` value or condition reading the event's `had_counters` snapshot summed over every kind
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The trigger filter key `has_counters` reads `obj.counters` at match time, but `zones` runs `reset_permanent_state` before LEAVES_BATTLEFIELD fires, so on a leave trigger it is always false (the card would never investigate). The value `counters_had` does read the snapshot but takes exactly one counter kind (`{"counters_had": "+1/+1"}`), and counter kinds are open-ended, so an `any` over a fixed list of kinds would miss oil, shield, stun, lore, etc. and be a narrower card
